strings.name: Amancio Ortega
strings.role: Founder of Zara and Inditex · Clothing retail
strings.summary: Amancio Ortega began in clothing production in A Coruña and built Zara with collaborators including Rosalía Mera. He helped develop Inditex into an international retailer by connecting design, manufacturing, logistics and store feedback. After leaving the chairmanship, he remained a major shareholder and supported education and healthcare through his foundation.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026. The timeline selects corporate and philanthropic milestones through 2025; public activity in 2026 was also checked. Company achievements reflect team contributions, not wealth rankings.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Zara and Inditex, advancing fast-response supply chains and global clothing retail.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education or early career
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Worked in clothing shops in A Coruña as a teenager
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Retail and supply chains
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: Connected production, logistics and store demand, supporting Zara’s international expansion.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Education and healthcare giving
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Established his foundation in 2001 to support educational opportunity and social welfare.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Zara turns fifty
strings.timeline.event-1.text: Inditex reviewed its international development since the first store opened in 1975.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Steps down as Inditex chairman
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Handed the chairmanship to Pablo Isla while remaining an influential shareholder.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Stock-market listing and foundation
strings.timeline.event-3.text: Inditex listed in Madrid; the Amancio Ortega Foundation was established that year.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: International expansion
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Zara opened in Portugal, followed by stores in New York and Paris.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Inditex established
strings.timeline.event-5.text: Brought clothing manufacturing and retail businesses into one group.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: First Zara store
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Opened in A Coruña, extending the manufacturing business into retail.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Confecciones GOA founded
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Established the clothing workshop that laid the group’s manufacturing foundations.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Born in Spain
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Born in Busdongo; moved to A Coruña and entered the clothing trade in his youth.
